title: merge.py sets "Guard or check" from the diff's paths
why: A change to hooks/, lint/, settings.json or .github/ gets the guard-or-check review without relying on the author's word.
note: Coordinator 12:20 CST, from the checks-and-balances audit (Opus Explore): Refuse a record that says "no" for such a diff. Refusing a missing record conflicts with item 113 a ("no refusal now"), so that half needs the stale-decision protocol and an owner question later.
